title: TRUE-Colon: Exposing a Consistent Transfer Asymmetry in Real-Time Polyp Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.13711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-aided detection (CADe) systems for colonoscopy promise to reduce clinical miss rates, yet reliable real-world deployment remains elusive. This translational gap stems in part from a structural flaw in model development: the reliance on curated datasets that under-represent the long negative stretches and procedure-related artifacts characteristic of routine examinations. Training and evaluating architectures strictly on these lesion-centric benchmarks creates an illusion of success, since such benchmarks cannot capture clinically crucial metrics. To expose this gap, we establish TRUE-Colon, a standardized benchmarking protocol that measures key deployment characteristics alongside localization accuracy, and evaluate four real-time architectures (Faster R-CNN, YOLOv8, YOLOv11, RT-DETR) across curated benchmarks (SUN, PICCOLO) and 60 unedited, full-length procedures (REAL-Colon). translated_title: TRUE-Colon：在实时息肉检测中揭示一致的迁移不对称性
translated_abstract: 用于结肠镜检查的计算机辅助检测（CADe）系统有望降低临床漏诊率，但可靠的现实世界部署仍然难以实现。这一转化差距部分源于模型开发中的结构性缺陷：依赖精心策划的数据集，这些数据集未能充分代表常规检查中典型的长阴性片段和与手术相关的伪影。仅在这些以病灶为中心的基准上训练和评估架构会产生一种成功错觉，因为此类基准无法捕捉临床关键指标。为揭示这一差距，我们建立了TRUE-Colon，一种标准化基准测试协议，该协议在测量定位准确性的同时衡量关键部署特性，并评估四种实时架构（Faster R-CNN、YOLOv8、YOLOv11、RT-DETR），涵盖精心策划的基准（SUN、PICCOLO）和60个未经编辑的全长手术（REAL-Colon）。我们观察到一种一致的迁移不对称性：模型
tldr: 本文提出TRUE-Colon标准化基准协议，揭示基于精选数据集训练的实时息肉检测模型在真实临床全流程中表现出一致的迁移不对称性，即性能显著下降，暴露了现有评估方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRUE-Colon, a standardized benchmarking protocol that reveals a consistent transfer asymmetry in real-time polyp detection models, showing significant performance degradation from curated benchmarks to full-length clinical procedures, exposing limitations in current evaluation methods.
